goal: An iteration that returns a 429/overload/rate-limit status is retried after bounded backoff on a transient budget separate from validation max_retries, terminating after a bounded number of attempts.

relevant: packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/harness.py -- the task driver / iteration loop that owns max_retries and currently turns a 429 into a MissingEnvelope/AGENT_ERROR; add the transient iteration-retry here
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/invoker.py -- api_error_status (line ~248) and rate_limit_events (~263) are already collected on InvocationSignals; consume them, do not re-derive
packages/flywheel-core/tests/test_harness.py -- add rate_limit_retry and rate_limit_exhausted tests here
constraints: Reuse the TRANSIENT classification and bounded-backoff helper from transient-classifier-backoff; do not introduce a second backoff or budget definition
The transient-retry budget MUST be tracked separately from the harness validation max_retries: criterion proof runs with max_retries=0 and still reaches DONE on [rate-limit, rate-limit, valid-pass]
rate_limit_exhausted: N+1 rate-limit results (N = transient budget) terminates in bounded time with a TRANSIENT-classified failure and attempt count N+1 -- never an unbounded loop
A genuine non-API MissingEnvelope (no api_error_status / no rate-limit event) must STILL consume the validation budget and reach AGENT_ERROR/FAILED_VALIDATION as before
import flywheel_core must work without claude-agent-sdk; touch the SDK only through _sdk
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done
non_goals: Do not modify files under tests/ except adding the two named tests; do not weaken existing harness tests
Do not raise the default max_retries to absorb 429s -- that conflates infra faults with agent failures and is explicitly rejected (D-1)
edge_cases: max_retries=0 must still let two rate-limited iterations precede a passing one and reach DONE -- proving the validation budget was untouched
The retry loop must be bounded by the transient budget, not by a value an agent could set to infinity
